The '''ASN courier droid''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]-powered [[Droid/Legends|droid]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:ASNCourierDroidDiagram-FFp65.png|thumb|left|250px|An ASN courier droid schematic]]
The model was able to carry communications cylinders in a frontal tool chuck.

==History==
The [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] assassin [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] used [[ASN-121/Legends|ASN-121]], a modified ASN droid made by the [[Malkite Poisoners]], to serve as her personal [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] would be used in an attempt to kill [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. ASN-121 was carrying two [[Kouhun/Legends|Kouhuns]] in an attempt to silently assassinate the senator. The plot was foiled by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], however.

ASNs were used as shooting range targets as part of the training of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooters]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Sharpshooter">{{SWArchive|url=games/playnow/sharpshooter|text=Sharpshooter|int=Sharpshooter (game)}}</ref>

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Aside from ASN-121, several ASN models appeared as enemies in the GBA adaptation of ''Attack of the Clones'', where they occasionally appeared and dropped grenades.
